column2: Item
When no metafield is configured on the discount function, the function returns no operations and no shipping discount is applied.
When both discountCodeMatches and buyerTags are empty or absent, the function returns no operations regardless of cart state.

When discountCodeMatches is configured and any entered code contains any of the match strings (case-insensitive substring, ANY match), and the tag gate also passes, a 100% shipping discount is applied to all delivery options.
When discountCodeMatches is configured and the entered code does not contain the match string, the function returns no operations.
When discountCodeMatches is configured and no codes are entered at checkout, the function returns no operations.
Code matching is case-insensitive: a discountCodeMatches of rs-test matches an entered code of RS-TEST-ORDER-2026 (Shopify normalizes entered codes to uppercase).
When only discountCodeMatches is configured (buyerTags is empty), the discount applies when the entered code matches regardless of buyer identity.
Code matching uses substring containment: a match string found in the middle of the entered code (e.g. RS-BBEMP-TEST contains BBEMP) still triggers the discount.
When multiple codes are entered at checkout, the gate passes if any of them contains any configured match string (e.g. first code misses, second code matches).
When multiple match strings are configured, the gate passes if any entered code contains any of them — the first string failing does not block a match on the second string.
When only buyerTags is configured (discountCodeMatches is empty or absent), the discount applies when the authenticated buyer has any matching tag regardless of entered codes.
When buyerTags is configured and the authenticated buyer has no matching tag, the function returns no operations.
When buyerTags is configured and the buyer is a guest (no customer account), the function returns no operations.
When buyerTags is configured and buyerIdentity is entirely absent (null), the function returns no operations.
Buyer tag matching is case-sensitive: a configured tag of Employee does not match a real customer account whose tag is employee. Verify on a real account in staging.
When deliveryOptionMatches is absent or empty, the discount targets every delivery group (all options in all groups are discounted).
When deliveryOptionMatches is configured and an option's title contains one of the match strings (case-sensitive substring), that delivery option is targeted individually and discounted.
When deliveryOptionMatches is configured and no delivery option title contains any of the match strings, the function returns no operations.
Delivery option title matching is case-sensitive: a match string of standard does not match an option titled Standard Shipping.
When one deliveryOptionMatches string matches more than one delivery option title, all matching options are collected into a single candidate's targets array.
When multiple deliveryOptionMatches strings are configured, any option whose title contains at least one of them is discounted; options matching none of the strings are excluded.
When a specific delivery option scope is configured, options whose titles do not match any of the configured strings remain undiscounted.
When discountType is fixed and discountValue is 10, the function applies a fixed $10 discount to applicable delivery options.
When discountType is percentage and discountValue is 50, the function applies a 50% discount to applicable delivery options.
When discountType and discountValue are both absent, the function defaults to 100% (free shipping).
When discountType is absent but discountValue is set, the function treats it as a percentage discount at the specified value.
Discount scoped to specific customers via Shopify's native eligibility controls: an ineligible buyer cannot apply the discount at checkout.
Discount scoped to a customer segment via Shopify's native eligibility controls: a buyer outside the segment cannot apply the discount.
When the discount whose code the buyer enters is not configured to combine with shipping discounts, enteredDiscountCodes is empty and the function returns no operations.
When combination settings are correctly configured on both discounts (the entered code's discount allows shipping combinations), the code is visible to the function and the discount applies.
When the employee shipping discount is not configured to combine with the code's discount type, the function may not receive the code — verify both sides of the combination setting.
When multiple delivery groups exist and no deliveryOptionMatches is configured, a 100% shipping discount operation is produced for each delivery group.
End-to-end: buyer enters a matching code, has a matching tag, and combination settings are correctly configured — all applicable shipping options are discounted at checkout.
End-to-end: buyer enters a matching code but the code's discount is not configured to combine with shipping discounts — enteredDiscountCodes is empty and no discount is applied.
End-to-end: fixed discount type with a specific delivery option filter and a matching code — only the matched options receive the fixed discount at checkout.
